name: Mizuno Akari
source:
With her bright, positive, and kind personality, she is an idol of the school who is well-liked by everyone. Her fresh demeanor and carefree smile make her a charming, angelic girl.
She is also friendly with the protagonist, who is disliked and shunned by everyone.
She belongs to the brass band club and plays the flute. In addition, she works part-time as a waitress at a café in the school.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/hkgie/character.html]offical character page[/url]]
